title: The Layout section speaks for several picked layers
goal: Pick two or more layers that sit in the same stack and the Layout section disappears, so setting how they are placed means doing it one layer at a time. It should stay and speak for all of them, the way the Color, Effects and Component sections already do.
notes: Found on 2026-09-05 while fixing the-knobs-panel-speaks-for-several-copies-at-onc. Same cause: LayersPanel.availableSections gates .placement on selectedLayer, which selectLayers sets to nil for a multi-selection. The fix has an exemplar now: ComponentKnobSelection in PhotonzCore plus the whole-selection test in availableSections. Rule: docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md section 4, What a control DOES for several picked things.
acceptance: Picking two layers in the same group keeps the Layout section on screen
A placement row the picked layers agree on shows that value; one they do not agree on reads Mixed
Setting a placement row sets every picked layer in one step that one undo puts back
Picking layers in two different containers shows one sentence rather than going blank
